name: Ashkenazi Jewish
description: Ashkenazi Jewish. Distinct genetic cluster intermediate between Southern European and Middle Eastern populations. Strong founder effects (~30 generations ago) and endogamy. Estimated from published PCA coordinates (Behar 2010, Carmi 2014, Lazaridis 2016).
source: Human Origins dataset (Lazaridis et al. 2016) + 1000G PCA projection
note: Approximate centroid based on published AJ position relative to TSI and CEU in European PCA space. Real AJ samples available in reference/human_origins/ for full integration.
